Allahabad High Court stays conviction for 2017 murder case

The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of an individual who was found guilty in a 2017 murder case. This stay allows the individual to contest elections in Uttar Pradesh in 2027. The court's decision was made in relation to the upcoming polls.
